question: Zambia centroid: 3 closest named river centerlines, km
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32735', always_xy := true) AS geom FROM countries WHERE name = 'Zambia') SELECT r.name AS river, r.feature_class, ROUND(ST_Distance(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32735', always_xy := true), t.geom) / 1000.0, 2) AS distance_km FROM target t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, feature_class, geometry FROM rivers WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL AND feature_class = 'River' ORDER BY ST_Distance(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32735', always_xy := true), t.geom) LIMIT 3) r ORDER BY distance_km, r.name

question: Ob geometry centroid: 5 nearest country centroids, km
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom FROM rivers WHERE name = 'Ob' AND geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY scalerank LIMIT 1) SELECT c.name AS country, c.continent, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(c.geometry), t.geom) / 1000.0, 2) AS distance_km FROM target t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, continent, geometry FROM countries WHERE geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(geometry), t.geom) LIMIT 5) c ORDER BY distance_km, c.name

question: Kenya surface point: other countries within 750 km
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_PointOnSurface(geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32737', always_xy := true) AS geom FROM countries WHERE name = 'Kenya') SELECT c.name AS country, c.continent, ROUND(ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32737', always_xy := true), t.geom) / 1000.0, 2) AS distance_km FROM target t JOIN countries c ON c.name <> 'Kenya' AND c.geometry IS NOT NULL WHERE ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32737', always_xy := true), t.geom, 750000) ORDER BY distance_km, c.name

question: Africa's 6 most populous countries: closest named river to each surface point, km
sql: WITH selected AS (SELECT name AS country, pop_est, ST_Transform(ST_PointOnSurface(geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true) AS geom FROM countries WHERE continent = 'Africa' AND geometry IS NOT NULL AND pop_est IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pop_est DESC LIMIT 6) SELECT s.country, s.pop_est, r.name AS nearest_river, r.feature_class, ROUND(ST_Distance(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true), s.geom) / 1000.0, 2) AS distance_km FROM selected s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, feature_class, geometry FROM rivers WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL AND feature_class = 'River' ORDER BY ST_Distance(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true), s.geom) LIMIT 1) r ORDER BY s.pop_est DESC, s.country

question: 5 most populous countries: nearest other country by border distance, km
sql: WITH selected AS (SELECT name AS country, geometry FROM countries WHERE pop_est IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pop_est DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT s.country, c.name AS nearest_country, c.continent, ROUND(ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(s.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true)) / 1000.0, 2) AS distance_km FROM selected s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, continent, geometry FROM countries WHERE name <> s.country AND geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST_Distance(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(s.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true)) LIMIT 1) c ORDER BY distance_km, s.country

question: Zambia border: named rivers within 500 km
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT ST_Boundary(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32735', always_xy := true)) AS geom FROM countries WHERE name = 'Zambia') SELECT r.name AS river, r.feature_class, ROUND(ST_Distance(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32735', always_xy := true), t.geom) / 1000.0, 2) AS distance_km FROM target t JOIN rivers r ON r.name IS NOT NULL AND r.geometry IS NOT NULL AND r.feature_class = 'River' WHERE ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32735', always_xy := true), t.geom, 500000) ORDER BY distance_km, r.name
